description: Print the remote Fabric Data Warehouse MCP server URLs (preview) for a Warehouse (also works for a SQL analytics endpoint via 'fabio sql-endpoint mcp-url'). External MCP clients (VS Code agent mode, GitHub Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry) connect to the item-scoped mcpUrl over HTTP transport with Fabric auth to run T-SQL. fabio constructs the deterministic /mcp/dataPlane/.../sqlEndpoint URL because agents cannot guess it.

data.note: Consume the item-scoped mcpUrl as a remote MCP server (HTTP transport) ... The remote server (preview) exposes a single T-SQL execution tool (execute_query). For scripted execution, execution plans, query insights, and statistics, prefer fabio's native commands.

notes: Two endpoint shapes: item-scoped (mcpUrl, binds to this warehouse/SQL-endpoint item) and global (globalMcpUrl, /mcp/dataPlane/sqlEndpoint, where the agent supplies workspace+item context per-prompt). Live-verified: an MCP 'initialize' handshake returns serverInfo 'microsoft.fabric.sqlEndpoint' and 'tools/list' exposes ONE tool named 'execute_query' (inputs workspaceId/itemId/query) — the docs table calls it 'executeSQL', but the live server tool name is 'execute_query'. There are NO separate schema/metadata tools, so agents discover schema via INFORMATION_SCHEMA / sys.* queries through execute_query. Uses the signed-in user's Entra identity and respects existing Fabric + SQL permissions. When the id is not found, the command still emits the deterministic URLs but sets exists=false with a hint. Division of labor: use the remote MCP server for interactive Copilot-in-VS-Code SQL authoring; use fabio's native warehouse/sql-endpoint query, plan, queries-*, statistics-* for scripted/composable execution, execution plans, monitoring, and statistics.
